newsitem.title: USA: Amresco adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Amresco adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Amresco Inc said it has adopted a shareholder rights plan with a 15 percent trigger.

The diversified financial services company said the plan was adopted to protect it from hostile takeover attempts and to prevent a potential bidder from gaining control without fairly compensating shareholders.

The plan creates a dividend of one right for each outstanding share of the company's common stock. The rights would be exercisable unless a person has acquired or made an offer to acquire 15 percent or more of Amresco common stock.
If that were to occur, each right would entitle the holder to buy 1/1000th of a share of Amresco Series A preferred stock at an exercise price of $125, the company said.
The distribution of the rights is to be made to stockholders of record as of June 9.
